simple.meaning: לָעַז (lâʻaz) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to speak in a foreign tongue.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Psalms, beginning at Psalms 114:1. The surrounding contexts include Egypt, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to לָעַז (H3937) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: לָעַז (lâʻaz) / H3937 is traced through Psalms 114:1 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.short: to speak in a foreign tongue
definitions.full: H3937. laaz [ לָעַז ] verb talk indistinctly, unintelligibly (Late Hebrew id. , in derivatives ( לַעַז foreign language , לָעוּז foreigner ), also murmur, remonstrate ; Syriac talk indistinctly ; Arabic distort ; IV. talk obscurely, ambiguously ); — only Qal Participle לֹעֵז עַם Psa 114:1 a people talking unintelligibly (|| מִצְרַיִם ).
